Vendor initialization data adapted from 78/xiaozhi-esp32@49b4380b3faa0ceadd28a3e78aaf0f311c46c57e, Waveshare3.5 esp32-s3-touch-lcd-3.5.cc and3.5B waveshare-s3-touch-lcd-3.5b.cc. All active commands/payloads/order/delays retained as fixed-size C++ data; commented MADCTL in3.5 excluded. MIT terms retained in LICENSE; no entire board/application/custom LVGL class copied, no project-wide license change. Local code uses official ST7796 1.4.0 or AXS15231B 2.1.0 panel APIs. B uses bounded DMA stripes with checked completion and a complete software-rotated frame to satisfy QSPI sequential RAMWR/RAMWRC semantics.
